query: *** WHAT THIS DOES AND DOES NOT MEAN ***
verdict: *** IT MEANS: the man named on the card is absent from FamilySearch's INDEXED corpus, and so is the marriage that would name him. *** The route to Pablo Armando's parents does not run through the indexes, and further index searching is *** not *** where the next hour should go. *** IT DOES NOT MEAN he did not exist, and it does not exclude him from the records themselves. *** This tests the *** exact *** string 'Juan Carlos'. A record indexed as *** 'Juan C.', 'J. C.', or plain 'Juan' *** would not match - and the fuzzy form of this search returns 47, among them the children of a *** Juan Lerena and Eduviges Pelaez at Trinidad, Flores ***, whom this archive already holds. *** And it tests INDEXED records only. *** Unindexed images are a separate corpus with its own search.

*** Away from indexes and towards registers read by eye. *** The 1882 Rosario walk already proved the index complete across 750 consecutive acts, February to July, with no Lerena - so he was not baptised at the Catedral. *** Between them, those two results say the parents' generation is not in any indexed corpus this archive can reach ***, and the remaining routes are unindexed images, Argentine civil registration, and the other Rosario parishes.
